## Introduction

## Comprehensive Coverage for a Worry-Free Tomorrow

Picture this: a health insurance plan that feels like it was made just for you. One that's got your back during a rainy-day fever in Kerala, cheers you on for those morning walks in Punjab, and even steps up with extra care during your favourite festival in Karnataka. That's Mee Kosam-Bajaj General's commitment to reach every individual and family across India.

Meaning "For You," this isn't just a policy; it's a promise to blend rock-solid coverage with a sprinkle of local magic, tailored to 25 unique regions. From the hustle of Uttar Pradesh to the calm of Himachal, we're here to make sure you're protected, celebrated, and empowered-because your health isn't just a priority, it's personal. Fair and region-specific pricing, festival-ready coverage, and rewards for your healthy habits make it a plan that's as unique as your fingerprint. Ready to see how it is made Mee Kosam? Let's get started!

## Why Choose Mee Kosam?

It is designed for you (Mee Kosam) in such a way that ensures the policy reaches even the last person in a region.

Accessibility and Fairness: Premium rates are adjusted based on regional healthcare costs, ensuring equitable pricing that reflects local economic conditions. This makes the policy accessible to a broader audience.

Cultural Relevance: With festival-specific coverage, the policy offers enhanced protection during significant cultural events-whether unique to a region or celebrated nationwide-aligning seamlessly with policyholders' lifestyles.

Inclusive Underwriting: Underwriting relaxations to make health insurance accessible and inclusive for individuals with lifestyle conditions.

Claims: Specially designed regional materials for claims communications, incorporating local branding to ensure ease of understanding What are the Sum Insured options available under the policy?

## What Will we pay for

## In patient Hospitalisation Treatment Sum Insured

Stay Covered, Stay Confident

Experience peace of mind with our comprehensive in-patient hospitalization cover. Whether it's a planned surgery or an unexpected illness, we've got you covered. Focus on your recovery while we handle the rest.

## Room Rent

Hassle-Free and Comfortable Stays

Choose comfort without worrying about costs. Our room rent covers a Standard Airconditioned Room ensuring you get the best care in a comfortable setting.

## ICU

Critical Care, Covered

Support Beyond the Hospital

Recovery doesn't end at discharge. Our post-hospitalization cover supports your journey back to health, covering follow-up treatments and consultations up to 60 days after discharge.

Advanced Care, Short Stays

## Cumulative Bonus

Your Health, Our Reward

<!-- image -->

## Walk To Win

Step up your health

Love a win-win situation? Lace up those sneakers! Hit 7,500 steps a day for 24 days a month (9 months a year) and score a 5% discount at renewal. Feeling extra peppy? Bump it to 10,000 steps for a 10% discount. Your morning walks just turned into a money-saving superpower!

## Festive Protect

Festive cheer, covered here

Imagine getting sick just before the celebrations commence. With our Festive Protect, an emergency hospital stay during your state's big festival week gets you an extra INR 1,000 per day (up to 10 days). So, while you're recovering, we're adding a little festive cheer to your wallet!

<!-- image -->

## Optional Covers

## Sum Insured Reinstatement

<!-- image -->

Coverage That Bounces Back!

With our Sum Insured Reinstatement, your inpatient hospitalization coverage gets a fresh start if exhausted.

Choose one-time or unlimited reinstatements each policy year for tailored, continuous protection.

## Procedure-wise/Disease-wise Sublimit

Limitless Health

Cap your costs and score a 15% discount if you're under 35, or 20% off for those 35+, because your health deserves the best!

## Super Cumulative Bonus

Healthy Choices, Healthier Coverage

Unlike standard policies that remain static, our Super Cumulative Bonus feature transforms your health insurance into a growing asset. Choose from flexible growth options that match your health goals:

Option 1: 25% of Sum Insured every year up to 100% of SI

Option 2: 25% of Sum Insured every year up to 200% of SI

Option 3: 50% of Sum Insured every year up to 100% of SI

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

## No Claim Discount

<!-- image -->

The Smart Switch: Premium Relief When You Need It

We understand everyone's financial needs differ. Our No Claim Discount trades in your accumulated bonus (Cumulative Bonus/Super Cumulative Bonus) with an immediate 1.5% discount on your next premium payment-because we believe staying healthy should benefit your wallet today, not just tomorrow

## Cashless Discount

Cashless Convenience, Premium Savings!

Enjoy a 5% discount on your premium by choosing cashless claims at our network hospitals-no upfront payments, just seamless care.

Opt for reimbursement instead? A 20% co-pay applies, except for pre/post-hospitalization expenses and procedures with sublimits.

## Accidental Death Cover

<!-- image -->

A Promise of Protection

When the unthinkable happens, we stand by your family. Our Accidental Death Cover provides financial protection for your loved ones, ensuring they're cared for even when you can't be there

## Health Prime Rider OPD

Your Complete Health Companion

Discover the Health Prime Rider-your ultimate outpatient care companion! Enjoy instant teleconsultations, hassle-free in-clinic doctor visits, and coverage for essential diagnostic tests. Stay proactive with annual health check-ups, all designed to keep you thriving every day.

## Discounts

<!-- image -->

## Loyalty Discount:

If you have an ongoing BGIL policy (Motor, Health, Home, Cyber, or Pet Insurance) with a minimum premium of INR 2500, you get an extra 5% Loyalty Discount!

## Family Discount:

Get a 10% discount for insuring two family members or 15% for three or more under one policy, applicable to new and renewal policies (excludes Floater Policies).

<!-- image -->

## Employee Discount:

Score a 20% discount on premium rates! Employees of Bajaj General, group companies, corporate clients, and intermediaries can enjoy this exclusive offer for policies booked directly. Intermediaries, you're covered too-just ensure you're included in the policy.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

## Online/Direct Business Discount:

Go digital and save 5% on policies purchased through direct or online channels. (Not combinable with Employee Discount.)

## Long Term Policy Discount:

Commit to longer coverage with a single payment and save:

- 4% off for a 2-year policy
- 8% off for a 3-year policy

## Voluntary Co-pay Discount:

Save More with Voluntary Co-pay! Choose a 5%, 10%, 15%, or 20% co-payment when you sign up, and enjoy the same percentage off your policy premium. If you file an in-patient hospitalization claim, you'll cover the chosen co-pay percentage, and we'll handle the rest, up to your Sum Insured.

<!-- image -->

<!-- image -->

## Voluntary Aggregate Deductible Discount:

Slash Your Premium with a Voluntary Aggregate Deductible! Choose a deductible amount (₹10,000 to ₹3,00,000) when you sign up, and unlock discounts on your policy premium, based on your Sum Insured (₹5,00,000 to ₹20,00,000). Check the table in the policy wordings for your savings!

## Walk to Win

Wellness pays off! Earn 5% off your renewal premium by hitting 7,500 steps a day for 24 days a month (9 months a year) and 10% by walking 10,000 steps.
